description: Whose rules a point is under. Every rule the engine holds is the FAA's: part 91 governs flight within the United States and the waters within 3 nm of its coast, most of its flight rules on to 12 nm (14 CFR 91.1(a), (b)); outside it a U.S. airplane flies by the foreign country's rules, and by ICAO Annex 2 over the high seas (14 CFR 91.703(a)). From Natural Earth's admin-0 countries at 1:50m (public domain), the United States with its territories and Canada, Mexico and the Bahamas; a point on no country's land is its nearest country's within 12 nm of its outline, else other. Warn, never limit (decision 0053).

code.description: US: the United States with its territories (14 CFR 1.1); CA Canada, MX Mexico, BS the Bahamas; other anywhere else, the high seas among it.

name.description: The country's name as the warning starts, "Canada"; "Outside the US" for other.

caution.description: The warning where the figures are, "Canada: rules not checked — figures use US rules"; null in the United States.
